Yes Bank’s ₹8,415 Crore AT1 Bond Crisis
Yes Bank’s recovery story has hit a major hurdle after the Supreme Court ruled that the bank’s 2020 write-off of ₹8,415 crore worth of Additional Tier 1 (AT1) bonds was illegal. The court’s decision has brought back a major financial liability for the bank, sending its stock down nearly 15% on the day of the ruling.
